title: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on Profile | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview on 6 February 1970 for the BBC radio show Profile.

It was recorded at the Lennons’ office in Apple’s headquarters in Savile Row, London. David Bellan was the interviewer. Profile was broadcast on the BBC World Service.

Among the subjects discussed was Lennon’s possible participation in the Toronto Peace Festival, and his relationship with Paul McCartney.
